children: Australian stocks are set to rise in early trade after slight gains on Wall Street earlier. Local stock futures are up by 0.5% ahead of Friday's open, suggesting that the S&P/ASX 200 will reverse some of Thursday's losses. The benchmark index tumbled by 2.0% last session, hitting its lowest level since June. There is little stock-specific news ahead of the bell to drive shares. In the U.S., S&P 500 rose 0.19% while the Dow Jones Industrial Average and the Nasdaq both edged up 0.04%. (rhiannon.hoyle@wsj.com; @RhiannonHoyle)
